panels.title: The Story Begins
panels.caption: In the old library, a dusty Tome flutters open all by itself.

panels.title: Long Ago...
panels.caption: The magical towers fell, and the floating islands began to drift apart.

panels.title: The Lost Tomes
panels.caption: Every spellbook was lost. Win them back, one tower at a time!

panels.title: Explore the Biomes!
panels.caption: All aboard the block-cart! Next stop: somewhere wobbly.

panels.title: Canopy Chaos
panels.caption: A bumpy jungle road, a cart of stone blocks, and cheeky monkeys!

panels.title: Defend the Fort!
panels.caption: Goblins! They think our cart is lunch. Build those walls, quick!

panels.title: The Molten Guardian
panels.caption: The forge guardian wakes up hot and grumpy. Help him cool down!

panels.title: The Cosmic Gateway
panels.caption: High above the stars, a glowing doorway waits for one last tower.

panels.title: The Cosmic Nexus
panels.caption: Blocks zoom between the portals, and the way home opens wide!

panels.title: The Grand Finale!
panels.caption: The towers rise again, and look... the treasure was here all along!

panels.title: Learn to Stack!
panels.caption: Every great builder starts with one block. Let's try it!

panels.title: The Angry Wind Cloud
panels.caption: Whoosh! A grumpy cloud is blowing the whole sky sideways. Hold on!

panels.title: The Stone Guardian
panels.caption: Shh! Tiptoe past the sleepy guardian and grab the glowing keys.

panels.title: The Rainbow Kraken
panels.caption: A giant rainbow octopus blocks the cove. It just wants to play!

panels.title: Pirate Cove
panels.caption: Ahoy! Golden sand, a giggly Tiki, and a brand-new treasure map.

panels.title: The Tumble Fair
panels.caption: Step right up! Lanterns, tents, and one very proud balloon.

panels.title: The Tournament!
panels.caption: Builders from every island, one golden trophy. May the best tower win!

panels.title: The Fair Plaza
panels.caption: Four bridges, four games, and a scoreboard that never stops cheering.

panels.title: The Last Tower
panels.caption: Wait a moment... the tallest tower of all is the wizard's hat!

panels.title: The Invitation
panels.caption: The violet ribbons were one big invitation, and someone saved a seat!

c2.name: Dame Ada
c2.bio: A brave young knight with a soft heart who keeps every tower standing.

c3.name: Bram
c3.bio: A gruff, cheerful dwarf who loves a good smash. If it's in the way, it's coming down!

c4.name: Sif
c4.bio: A quick, curious elf who spots the gap and plans the next move before anyone else.
